title: Spain’s Complex Ties With Morocco Fuel Speculation Over Ceuta Migrant Surge
summary_full: Rumors swirled that Morocco, perhaps spurred by Israel and the United States, organized a recent border disaster. That unproven speculation, experts said, was exacerbated by the region’s complicated history.
